changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Score') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[Score] ( [AssetUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [EffectiveDate] [date] NOT NULL, [Value] [decimal](8, 6) NOT NULL, [RunDate] [datetime] NULL, [EndDate] [date] NULL, [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [AllocationUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [VersionValueHash] [varchar](50) NULL ) END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
if not exists (select 1 from [sys].[key_constraints] where name = 'PK_MetricScore') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Score] ADD CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricScore] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [Uid] ASC ) end
if not exists (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS] where constraint_name = 'FK_MetricScore_MetricAllocation') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Score] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricScore_MetricAllocation] FOREIGN KEY([AllocationUid]) REFERENCES [metrics].[Allocation] ([Uid]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Score] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricScore_MetricAllocation] end
if not exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricsNewScore_EffectiveDate') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Score] ADD CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricsNewScore_EffectiveDate] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) FOR [EffectiveDate] end
if not exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricScore_Uid') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Score] ADD CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricScore_Uid] DEFAULT (newid()) FOR [Uid] end
changeSet.rollback:
if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricsNewScore_EffectiveDate') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Score] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricsNewScore_EffectiveDate] end
if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricScore_Uid') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Score] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricScore_Uid] end
if exists (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS] where constraint_name = 'FK_MetricScore_MetricAllocation') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Score] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricScore_MetricAllocation] end
if exists (select 1 from [sys].[key_constraints] where name = 'PK_MetricScore') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Score] DROP CONSTRAINT PK_MetricScore WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) end

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_MetricScore') begin CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX [CIX_MetricScore] ON [metrics].[Score] ( [AssetUid] ASC, [AllocationUid] ASC, [EffectiveDate] DESC ) end
changeSet.rollback: if exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_MetricScore') begin DROP INDEX [CIX_MetricScore] ON [metrics].[Score] WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) end
